title: Spot completed stories that need review

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Maintained proof caught a broken successful-Unreview propagation path for `SEED-333#spot-completed-stories-that-need-review` at revision `3ccc654c5818ad03dd5a53dced60e975b6168219`.

Story source: `.planning/seeds/SEED-333-spot-completed-stories-that-need-review.md#spot-completed-stories-that-need-review`, especially Scope and examples 2–3; plan: `.planning/slice-plans/608-spot-completed-stories-that-need-review/PLAN.md`. The selected promise is that a successful card review change updates linked rows using the correct project's story identity. This finding is bounded to the observed local row after Unreview, with identically named identities in another project as controls.

**Next proof action:** Retain the existing propagation assertion. This probe indicates no assertion repair for the observed path.

**Prior disposition:** The plan already required card-to-row propagation proof. The earlier scratch result supplied by the caller was only a targeting hint; this invocation established its own current-revision baseline, faulted observation, and restored pass. It creates no new repair decision.

The one-line scratch fault was in `dashboard/src/RecentlyDonePageEvidence.tsx:25`: `<StoryReviewStatesOnPage value={states}>` became `<StoryReviewStatesOnPage value={undefined}>`. This disconnects the shared page store and makes consumers use separate local stores. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

The maintained fixture `keepReviewCueProjects` in `dashboard/tests/recentlyDoneReviewCueJourney.ts` publishes `SEED-501#finished-in-pygardon` in both Open Dough and Pygardon, initially reviewed only in Open Dough. It shows the local matching row and two Pygardon rows. The selected test is `dashboard/tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-review-cue.spec.ts:53`, “equal identities use their own project's review state; every shown matching row shares successful card changes”.

The same focused command ran for baseline, fault, and restoration; only the outside-checkout proof-record destination changed:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- --workers=1 dashboard/tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-review-cue.spec.ts --grep "equal identities use their own project's review state; every shown matching row shares successful card changes$"
```

- Baseline: exit 0; one Chromium test selected and passed. The complete test reached Unreview, the local-row warning, Mark as reviewed, its removal, and the cross-project controls.
- Fault: exit 1; the same one test reached the initially reviewed card and successful Unreview, then failed at spec line 79. The actual catch was `expect(cue).toBeVisible()` in `dashboard/tests/recentlyDoneSessionsSidebarPage.ts:89`: the local row's “Needs review” element was absent. Earlier project, initial-state, and catalog-read assertions passed.
- Independent wrong-behavior observation: inspection of retained trace network resources showed POST `story-review-states?id=open-dough` with `{"identity":"SEED-501#finished-in-pygardon","reviewed":false}`, HTTP 200, and `{"reviewed":[]}`. The captured page snapshot separately showed the local card's “Mark as reviewed” button and “Marked as not reviewed.” status, while its matching sidebar row lacked “Needs review”. Both Pygardon rows still showed it and Open Dough remained selected. This establishes broken propagation after a successful save, beyond merely observing assertion failure.
- Restoration: restored the original file in a `finally` block protected for interruption, compared state, and reran the identical focused command: exit 0, one test passed. All three attempts had retry 0.

Preparation used an owned detached scratch worktree at the exact selected revision, with its own `npm ci` installation; `node_modules` was a real directory, not a copied or symlinked mutable installation. Each proof launch rechecked AC power and ran one worker under `caffeinate -s -i`. Other Board/session work was active; natural one-minute loads before the three runs were 35.48, 31.23, and 30.14, with 42%, 39%, and 44% memory free. No other processes were modified.

One initial command selected zero tests because its leading `^` anchored against Playwright's full project/file/title string. The title-suffix grep above corrected discovery before any fault was applied. That unsuccessful discovery run is retained separately and supplies no baseline evidence.

Final scratch HEAD and tracked tree matched the pre-probe state (`3f87deb3ca38fbf35d56d10e06e1ad9c69d758bb`), with empty status and empty staged/unstaged diffs. Restored file SHA-256 matched its original bytes (`9156c42a6f26a1e9ed159db860337bef68f6c555189ae902b3f030105bc9ead0`). After the restored pass, the owned scratch checkout and its worktree registration were removed. Evidence remains outside the execution checkout at `/tmp/seed333-intent-coverage.o36jdo9o`, including three proof records, logs, fault patch, retained trace/context, independent observations, and restoration/cleanup records. The execution checkout, stashes, backlog, process-review records, and CI were untouched by this probe.

## Wrap-up disposition

Caught on the successful-Unreview propagation path: retain the maintained assertion; no correction or follow-up is required for this observed path. The deliberate scratch fault is not a delivered defect. The restored evidence records revision 3ccc654c5818ad03dd5a53dced60e975b6168219 and tracked tree 3f87deb3ca38fbf35d56d10e06e1ad9c69d758bb; the tree hash in the report is not a different checked revision.
